description: This file declares the API functions for retrieving device information such as ID, serial number, model, SKU, hardware and software versions, vendor details, manufacturing date, hostname, and security schema status. It is part of the OSP (OpenSync Platform) Unit API, providing interface definitions for device identification and configuration.

methods.name: osp_unit_id_get
methods.description: Returns device identification string, part of AWLAN_Node table.

methods.name: osp_unit_serial_get
methods.description: Returns device serial number string, derived from MAC address, part of AWLAN_Node table.

methods.name: osp_unit_model_get
methods.description: Returns device model string, may return CONFIG_TARGET_MODEL or false.

methods.name: osp_unit_sku_get
methods.description: Returns SKU string, used for inventory tracking, or false if unsupported.

methods.name: osp_unit_hw_revision_get
methods.description: Returns hardware version string, or false if not needed.

methods.name: osp_unit_platform_version_get
methods.description: Returns platform version string, or false if not needed.

methods.name: osp_unit_sw_version_get
methods.description: Returns software version string in specified format.

methods.name: osp_unit_vendor_name_get
methods.description: Returns vendor name string, or false if not needed.

methods.name: osp_unit_vendor_part_get
methods.description: Returns vendor part number string, or false if not needed.

methods.name: osp_unit_manufacturer_get
methods.description: Returns manufacturer name string, or false if unknown.

methods.name: osp_unit_factory_get
methods.description: Returns factory name string, or false if not needed.

methods.name: osp_unit_mfg_date_get
methods.description: Returns manufacturing date string in 'YYYY/WW' format, or false if not needed.

methods.name: osp_unit_dhcpc_hostname_get
methods.description: Returns hostname string for DHCP client in <SERIAL>_<MODEL> format.

methods.name: osp_unit_sec_schema_is_legacy
methods.description: Indicates if WPA3 security schema is legacy (returns true if legacy).
